speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: Hello, how are you?

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: Hello. I am doing well. Finally feeling good after being sick for awhile.

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: I am glad that you are feeling better.  Where are you located?

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: I live outside of Chicago. It a both a suburb and a more rural area.

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: I have been to Chicago, I really enjoyed it there.  We went in the Hancock observatory? I think that was the name.  And had a great breakfast buffet in Bronzville. I am in Pennsylvania but originally from MC.

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: Oh yes the Hancock observatory is a great spot. What does MC stand for?

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: I meant NC, sorry, just a typo.  I am still not used to the snow in PA.  We rarely had it in NC and if it did snow, everything closed. Could I ask for your help with something?

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: I have always really like NC. Only been to Pennsylvania once, Pittsburgh but it was a long time ago. Anyways, sure what is it?

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: I am trying to get donations for Save the Children from people who complete this task.  You can donate any amount, from $0-$2.00, but anything would help.  Is that something you would consider?

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: I would. Can you tell me a little bit more about what they do?

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: Sure, Save the Children is an organization that helps ensure children's rights to health, education, and safety around the world.

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: Do they help kids in the United States?

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: Yes, they also help alleviate child poverty in the US, but there is a particular lack of support for children in developing countries, especially in war zones. For instance, millions of Syrian children have grown up facing the daily threat of violence. In the first two months of 2018 alone, 1,000 children were reportedly killed or injured in intensifying violence.

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: Sounds like they do important work.  Are they government run?

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: No, it is a non-governmental organization that has impeccable credentials.

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: Cool. Well then yes I will make a donation.

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: Wow, that is great! I really appreciate it.  If more people would be willing to donate to organizations like this, they could help so many other children.  How much would you like to donate?

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: You are welcome. I will probably donate 20 cents.

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: I do appreciate that.  Every amount is valuable and cents add up to dollars.  I do need a firm commitment though, I can't take probably.

speaker: AIVV4VUFFYHHN
text: Yes I will make a donation.

speaker: A1WR3WTEHJEY2D
text: Thank you and enjoy the rest of your day!
